decision_statement: Keep the contract with B unchanged after the 12-month review: actual spend 338,400 EUR against 354,000 planned (-4.4 %), availability 96.8 %; no revision of the price schedule; the fleet office's planned 2027 scope extension (28 vehicles) goes through the contract's unit prices, not a new purchase.
context_at_decision: Months 1 to 12 (2026-10 to 2027-09): invoices 338,400 EUR, of which parts 141,200 (B's schedule held; no abnormally-low pattern); 419 vehicles on average; availability 96.8 % (target 96 %); 2 penalties applied (response time), 1,900 EUR. Compared with the last 12 months of the previous contract (471,000 EUR, 420 vehicles): 28 % less for the same scope. The DECP 2026 median for comparable contracts moved to 915 EUR per vehicle per year; B is at 843.
options_considered: Keep the contract unchanged and route the 28-vehicle extension through its unit prices (chosen): the price and the service hold; the extension stays within the contract's 10 % clause.
Negotiate a lower price given the volume: the price is already 8 % under the market median; a renegotiation would risk the service level for little gain.
Re-tender early to split into two lots: no reason to: the single lot performs.
required_inputs_used: DECP 2026 extract (median 915 EUR per vehicle per year)
Decisions DR-2026-0071 and DR-2026-0142 (plan and criteria)
assumptions_depended_on: The 28 added vehicles are of the same mix as the fleet.
success_criteria: Spend at 24 months at or below 708,000 EUR cumulated.

affirmation_record.method: signed approval in the procurement console

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this re-decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-METROPOLE-ACHATS-2026: the purchasing assistant (achats-assistant, version 3) drafted the comparison of the planned and actual spend from the invoice ledger and the availability reports; I reviewed the three options recorded here, kept the contract unchanged, and I am the accountable owner of this decision in my capacity as an employee of the Métropole.

re_decision_trigger: The 24-month review; a spend drift beyond 5 % of plan in any quarter; availability under 95 %.
